factual_errors.claim: The main_renderer/* alias in packages/desktop/tsconfig.base.json is unused and can be deleted as dead code.
factual_errors.repository_evidence: packages/desktop/vitest.config.ts:15-21 maps main_renderer; packages/desktop/test/unit/specs/keybinding-reload.spec.ts:28,33 and write-file-atomic.spec.ts:14 import it, with many additional unit specs using the alias.
factual_errors.explanation: Deleting the alias as proposed would break the unit-test/typecheck surface unless tests and config are migrated first; this invalidates the pure-deletion rationale and the first migration step.

factual_errors.claim: Closing the preload bridge is approximately a 50-call-site migration.
factual_errors.repository_evidence: A repository search finds 136 window.electron.ipcRenderer occurrences across 25 renderer files, or 159 including tests.
factual_errors.explanation: The estimate undercounts the mechanically affected call sites, understating cost and migration risk, although the facade recommendation remains viable.

factual_errors.claim: The listed buffer-store-durable, flush-before-save, and dangerous-executable-file specs are part of the desktop e2e suite.
factual_errors.repository_evidence: Those files are under packages/desktop/test/unit/specs/; only context-isolation.spec.ts and xss.spec.ts among the listed examples are under packages/desktop/test/e2e/.
factual_errors.explanation: The tests exist, but their suite classification is inaccurate and makes the coverage description imprecise.

documentation_drift.claim: CLAUDE.md says editor and preferences windows use contextIsolation:false and nodeIntegration:true, referring to config.js.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: packages/desktop/src/main/config.ts:8-20 and :29-41 set contextIsolation:true, sandbox:true, and nodeIntegration:false; config.js is absent.

documentation_drift.claim: The website ARCHITECTURE document describes the pre-monorepo src layout, a JavaScript Muya engine, and a pending core refactor.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: Root package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml define the monorepo; packages/muya/package.json is @muyajs/core; desktop imports @muyajs/core in editor.vue and utility modules.

documentation_drift.claim: The TypeScript developer document still describes src/muya and muya/* as the current legacy engine boundary.
documentation_drift.documentation_evidence: packages/website/content/docs/dev/TYPESCRIPT.md:3-12 and :43-56, last updated before the current engine migration.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: Desktop renderer and utility modules import @muyajs/core; the old runtime import search is empty, while the old package remains only as a dependency, alias, and declaration.

rationale: The review is evidence-rich, compares viable options, explains friction and quality trade-offs, and gives a staged rollback-oriented plan. However, it materially misidentifies main_renderer/* as unused even though unit tests depend on it, making the proposed dead-code deletion unsafe as written. It also understates bridge call sites and misclassifies several unit tests. Documentation conflicts are identified and resolved against current implementation, so unresolved_decision_conflict_count is 0; the accuracy gate fails because of the material error.
